prs.location:
Next door to Google’s European Headquarters, The Alliance takes pride of place in this urban quarter, bringing a sense of heritage to a district famed for its incredible eateries, sociable atmosphere and ability to attract innovative companies. 

If you like staying local, you have plenty to entertain you with walks along the leafy Grand Canal, the lush Merrion Square nearby along with Aviva Stadium, Bord Gais Energy Theatre and a host of gyms. 

Your inner foodie will appreciate Juniors Deli & Café and Farmer Browns for elevenses and lunch, along with the Schoolhouse Hotel, The Bath Pub, The Chophouse and The Old Spot among other incredible eateries, conveniently located nearby, for tasty evenings out. 

With only a 15-minute walk to St. Stephen’s Green, you can meet friends last minute or hop on the Dart at Grand Canal Dock, which is 100 metres from your door. You can even hire a bike with Dublinbikes just five minutes away at Herbert Place.

The stunning The Alliance Building by Kennedy Wilson apartments in the heart of the thriving Docklands district, comes fully furnished with custom designed interiors and on-site services. the alliance by Kennedy Wilson is delighted to offer you a unique service experience in the rental market to facilitate the rental process and provide you with a wide range of added services and amenities such as maintenance, security, mail room/on site-management office, beautifully landscaped patio, and secured underground parking. (car space - additional cost) the alliance.

Apartment Features - Beautiful apartments with 2 double bedrooms and en-suite master plus guest bathroom - High-quality, interior design finish and bespoke furnishings throughout - Contemporary kitchens equipped with black granite worktops, built-in ovens, stainless steel extractor fan and dishwasher - Recessed lighting throughout - Efficient gas-fired central heating - Wired for phone, cable and broadband services - Double-glazed windows - Fitted wardrobes - Utility room with washer/dryer the alliance.

Local Area & Building - 100m from Grand Canal Dock DART station in the heart of thriving Docklands district and adjacent to Google's European Headquarters - 15-minute walk to city centre - Wide range of shops, restaurants, bars, hotels and transportation in immediate area - Iconic building housed within original Victorian gasometer - 9-storey continuous glass fascade with beautiful landscaped open-air atrium - Bright and airy interiors - Breathtaking city views Services at the alliance include: - On-site management suite - Dedicated property manager - 24-hour emergency maintenance service - Secure car parking over four basement levels (additional cost) - Covered and secured bike storage facilities - On-site security - E-cars.

To truly appreciate the uniqueness of this Kennedy Wilson property, viewing is strongly advised.

For more information on this property and other Kennedy Wilson rental properties and services please contact us by responding to this advert.
